rulings.quote: Done — **BIF-026: APPROVE WITH RIDERS; STAYS PARTIAL.** This approves the policy default and accepts no completion.
rulings.policy:
**Native network policy and signed query audit — CT ruling, 27 October 2026: APPROVE WITH RIDERS.** The bounded native administration door is restricted to the current active native owner using a currently authorized native session. Network enforcement starts disabled and requires explicit owner review and enablement. Review identifies the exact policy revision, proposed IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR entries, trusted ingress and affected private doors. Policy replacement or disablement requires fresh owner authorization and review of the current policy revision. Refuse stale review and any enabled policy that excludes the reviewing owner’s current trusted ingress.

Once enabled, unknown or unlisted ingress is denied across every private application, authentication and API door. Request-supplied forwarded headers confer no admission. Network admission confers no identity, membership or analytical data grant. Recheck current authority and policy at mutation and protected-response boundaries.

Before releasing any native data response or export bytes, durably append its required redacted signed audit record and verify the signed chain and head. Missing signing capability, unavailable append or failed verification refuses the data response. Records identify the actor, delegated credential and tenant where applicable, timestamp, immutable query reference, effective scope fingerprint, relevant model and grant references, export row count where applicable, and outcome. Exclude filter values, raw rows, credentials and raw PHI. Audit inspection remains owner-only through this bounded door.

Owner-only administration is an interim bootstrap default. Complete BIF-026 retains owner-approved installation security-administrator delegation and separately scoped read-only audit-review delegation, with accountable principals, permitted actions, tenant and event scope where applicable, expiry and revocation. These grants confer no analytical data access. Every original identity, audit, encryption, custody, residency, retention, Evidence and sensitivity-label obligation remains required.
rulings.acceptanceRider:
Under the interim policy, enable, replace and disable network enforcement through the current native owner’s reviewed public door; refuse non-owner, machine-credential, stale-session, stale-policy and self-lockout attempts without changing policy. Assert independently the permitted and denied IPv4 and IPv6 cases, unknown ingress and forwarded-header refusal through every private router, and a permitted invited reader’s exact restricted result without broader data access.

Through native query and export doors, independently assert the signed audit identity, immutable query reference, effective scope, timestamp, outcome and applicable export count. Require refusal before data bytes are released when append, signing or chain verification fails; detect changed audit content and refuse unauthorized audit updates, deletion and inspection. Inspect retained records for excluded sensitive values and credentials.

For complete delegated administration, demonstrate an explicitly granted security administrator and a separately granted read-only auditor, assert their exact permitted actions and audit scope, refuse broader actions and data access, and prove expiry and revocation take effect. Browser proof shows changed screens at 1440 and 390 CSS pixels; assertions may run at 1440. Map every original and added acceptance sentence to its asserting test and line, run one mutation per sentence, and record the resulting exact-SHA Verify proof.
rulings.gap: CT APPROVED WITH RIDERS the bounded native network-policy and signed-query-audit default on 27 October 2026 at review pin 293a84834f09bc3a088c3a6cf4bf527d9f57477d. This resolves policy only; BIF-026 remains partial. Recorded implementation covers native IP controls and query audit. Exact-SHA proof of the synchronized riders remains unestablished. Still unproved: scoped security-administrator and read-only auditor delegation; complete authority and policy checks at transaction and response boundaries; audit-before-release coverage for every native data response and export; complete action and sensitivity-label audit; historical anonymization, signing-key rotation and archive and restore continuity; Auth SAML and OIDC and MFA and SCIM qualification through Auth and Base; encrypted transport, storage and backups, secret custody and complete owner retention controls; US placement across application data, analytical compute, backups and opt-in model processing; enforced compute and model egress boundaries; and read-only Evidence ingestion and access reviews. External immutable-storage attestation, provider qualification and legal compliance remain unproved. Native controls establish no compliance certification. Every original obligation remains required.
